## Summary

Describe the user-facing or maintainer-facing change.

## Validation

- [ ] `make contracts`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make build`

## Contracts and docs

- [ ] No schema/spec change
- [ ] Schema/spec/docs/tests updated together

## Security and release impact

- [ ] No new secret, credential, token, or live-provider dependency in required CI
- [ ] Release notes/changelog updated when user-visible behavior changes
